name: Ransomware Leak Watch
description: Tracks publicly reported ransomware-victim listings for authorized organizations from the allowed feed, de-duplicates re-posts and labels every listing as an unverified claim.

inputs.name: monitor_id
inputs.label: Exposure monitor id (create one in the Exposure tab)

legal_notes: Defensive exposure assessment for yourself, a verified consenting client, or an organization you are authorized to assess. Every lookup passes the consent, provider and domain-control gates and is audited. A report that data leaked is a lead, not proof that the record exists, is accurate or is still reachable. No passwords, hashes, tokens, identity documents, card numbers or leaked records are collected, stored or shown.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: Newly reported listings since the last run, each labelled as an unverified claim with its source reference.
capability_gaps: No provider was exercised against its live service in this build (fixture-tested). Have I Been Pwned needs your paid API key; Ransomware.live's free v2 interface is labelled personal use only.
The automation reads the monitor you created in the Exposure tab; it cannot widen its scope, and revoking the consent stops it.
A listing is an unverified claim by the actor. Corroborate it (press, regulator, the organization itself) before treating it as a confirmed incident.
